algorithm_title: Perform a level order traversal on a binary tree and return node values grouped by depth
evidence_summary: This suite provides partial behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with partial state-mutation evidence. Tree shape is fixed; empty-tree and single-node boundaries are not externally injectable through the program interface.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: state mutation.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as useful but incomplete evidence across the declared exercised behaviours; unexercised behaviours remain outside the direct evidence.
coverage_limitations: Tree shape is fixed; empty-tree and single-node boundaries are not externally injectable through the program interface.
